name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Okafor goes with Fungus, or Beacon goes with Diatoms — but not both.
If Lichen does not go with Dasari, then Beacon does not go with Diatoms.
Between Aurora and Forge, one goes with Geode and the other with Lichen.
Eklund, Lumen, and Geode belong to different colonists.
Dasari goes with Aurora if and only if Eklund goes with Algae.
Rios, Forge, and Lichen belong to different colonists.
Beacon goes with exactly one of Okafor, Fungus, or Lichen.
